macosNotifications.title: Enable Notifications on macOS
macosNotifications.intro: Notifications are currently disabled in your system settings. Follow the steps below to enable them:
macosNotifications.step1: Open System Settings on your Mac.
macosNotifications.step2: Navigate to the Notifications section in the left sidebar.
macosNotifications.step3: Find and select the Cockpit application from the list.
macosNotifications.step4: Toggle the Allow Notifications switch on.
macosNotifications.tip: Tip: If the app does not appear in the list, close and reopen it to trigger its registration in the system.
